The user will not be aware of Cloud Storage prefix '/bucket/path1' and there will be no such directory in the view. Eg 2 - (bucket_name: bucket, bucket_prefix: path1/path2, directory: '') The user will land at '/', and the view there will match that of /bucket/path1/path2.
